recognize_zh: 在紅血球重疊的厚區中，中間那顆嗜中性球的胞質內可見數個金黃色、具折光性的長方形結晶，旁邊細胞胞質呈泡沫狀空泡化，符合 EDTA 血液中形成的膽紅素結晶，並伴隨毒性變化。
features: Neutrophil containing several golden-yellow, refractile rectangular to rhomboid cytoplasmic crystals
Vacuolated, foamy neutrophil cytoplasm consistent with toxic change
Band or less segmented neutrophil at the top suggesting left shift
Thick area of smear with overlapping, crenated red cells limiting assessment
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with overlapping red cells, shows neutrophils with vacuolated cytoplasm and a less segmented form at the top of the field. One neutrophil contains several golden-yellow, refractile rectangular to rhomboid intracytoplasmic crystals. The thick smear region limits evaluation of red cell morphology. In an EDTA sample from a patient with marked hyperbilirubinemia, findings are consistent with in vitro bilirubin crystal formation in neutrophils, with accompanying toxic changes.

ddx.vs: Cryoglobulins appear as pale blue amorphous or crystalline extracellular and intracellular material that disappears when the sample is warmed, rather than golden refractile crystals.
Hemosiderin is granular and irregular, brown to blue-black and Prussian blue positive, not geometric rectangular crystals.
Hemozoin is fine brown-black granules or clumps and is accompanied by intraerythrocytic parasites.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal, colorless to pale, and derived from eosinophils rather than yellow rectangular crystals in neutrophils.
